title: Aureline M5 retirement tombstone
description: Canonical per-domain retirement tombstone for a retired M5 line, capability, bundle, command / deep link, schema-bearing surface, registry-visible package, or managed / new-tenant feature. It is the typed record that keeps a retired object discoverable historically while it stops looking selectable or claimable in install / update pickers, marketplace / detail surfaces, help / About truth cards, and CLI / headless inspect paths: it binds the stable identity anchor, the last-supported version marker, the archival pointer, the replacement / successor path, and the removed active-selection affordance (green / support badges and active enablement removed) to one retired-object identity. Install / update, marketplace, help / About, and CLI / headless surfaces point at this schema so they read the retired-state truth directly from the tombstone instead of a stale selection UI. The stable identity anchor, last-supported version marker, archival pointer, and replacement path are mandatory; a tombstone missing any of them would let a retired surface disappear without a tombstone, successor pointer, or archival route. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
